property_summary: For any successful Collect(_am) by caller k, the balance recorded at any key must never exceed the maximum of the caller's pre-call balance and the pre-existing balances of all keys plus _am, because the reference only subtracts _am from the caller (never crediting anyone), whereas the mutant adds _am back to the caller, inflating a total that must be bounded by the initial sum plus the deposited value.
change_summary: Replace subtraction in the Collect balance update with addition, crediting the caller instead of debiting them.
